pages.title: Read the situation
pages.instruction: Read for the facts and the different priorities
pages.author: Scenario briefing · fictional
pages.subject: He said he’d come on Thursday
paragraphs: Original repair message: “I’ll come on Thursday at ten. Please leave a spare key at reception. The repair should take about an hour, but I need to see the tap first.” Pass on the details; do not assume the repair is guaranteed to finish within an hour.

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Did the repair person call about the leak?
lines.audioText: Did the repair person call about the leak?
lines.translation: O profissional ligou sobre o vazamento?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Yes. He said he’d come on Thursday at ten
lines.audioText: Yes. He said he’d come on Thursday at ten.
lines.translation: Sim. Disse que viria na quinta às dez

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Friday at ten? I’ll tell the building manager
lines.audioText: Friday at ten? I’ll tell the building manager.
lines.translation: Sexta às dez? Vou avisar a administração do prédio

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Thursday, not Friday. He asked us to leave a spare key at reception
lines.audioText: Thursday, not Friday. He asked us to leave a spare key at reception.
lines.translation: Quinta, não sexta. Pediu para deixarmos uma chave reserva na portaria

questions.hint: He said he’d come on … at …

questions.answer: Kim heard Friday instead of Thursday

questions.answer: He asked them to leave a spare key at reception

pages.title: Practise the conversation
pages.instruction: You are Ana and Teacher is Kim. Practise together, swap roles, then answer the questions

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: Thanks for checking. Did he say how long the repair would take?
lines.audioText: Thanks for checking. Did he say how long the repair would take?
lines.translation: Obrigada por conferir. Ele disse quanto tempo o reparo levaria?

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: He said about an hour, but he’d need to see the tap first
lines.audioText: He said about an hour, but he’d need to see the tap first.
lines.translation: Disse que cerca de uma hora, mas precisaria ver a torneira primeiro

lines.speaker: Kim
lines.text: All right. I’ll repeat that back: Thursday, ten, and a key at reception
lines.audioText: All right. I’ll repeat that back: Thursday, ten, and a key at reception.
lines.translation: Tudo bem. Vou repetir: quinta, dez, e chave na portaria

lines.speaker: Ana
lines.text: Exactly. Please ask the manager to confirm that someone can let him in
lines.audioText: Exactly. Please ask the manager to confirm that someone can let him in.
lines.translation: Isso. Peça à administração para confirmar que alguém poderá deixá-lo entrar

questions.answer: No, the estimate depended on seeing the tap first

questions.prompt: What details does Kim repeat back?
questions.answer: Kim repeats Thursday, ten and a key at reception
The manager should confirm that someone can let the repair person in

pages.title: Pass on a message
pages.instruction: Pass the repair worker’s message to Teacher, your housemate. Check the appointment and spare-key request

pages.title: Report statements and requests
pages.instruction: Choose said, told or asked, then build the clause that follows

rows.subject: Report a statement
rows.example: “I’ll come Thursday” → He said he would come Thursday

rows.subject: Name the listener
rows.example: He told me he would check the tap

rows.subject: Report a request
rows.verb: asked + person + to / not to + base verb
rows.example: “Leave a key” → He asked us to leave a key

pages.note: After a past reporting verb, will often changes to would and am/is to was. Tense changes depend on whether the information is still current. Told needs a listener; said does not.

pages.title: Use the information to respond
pages.instruction: Pass the message on. Pass the message to me and check that I understood it

pages.title: Listen and answer
pages.instruction: The repair has been rescheduled. Listen for the new information and decide how to respond
pages.message: Hi, Ana. I’ve had another call about the repair. He said he couldn’t come on Thursday after all and would come on Friday at eleven instead. He still asked us to leave the spare key at reception. He also said the visit might take longer than an hour if the tap needs replacing. Could you pass that on to the building manager and check that the new time has been understood? The earlier Thursday booking should be removed from the diary
pages.audioText: Hi, Ana. I’ve had another call about the repair. He said he couldn’t come on Thursday after all and would come on Friday at eleven instead. He still asked us to leave the spare key at reception. He also said the visit might take longer than an hour if the tap needs replacing. Could you pass that on to the building manager and check that the new time has been understood? The earlier Thursday booking should be removed from the diary.
